entities.summary: Edmon Hrachiki Marukyan is an Armenian lawyer and politician, chairman of Bright Armenia party and Member of the Council of Reforms of the Constitution of Armenia since 2022. He was a member of the National Assembly of Armenia from 2012 to 2021. He was elected to parliament for the first time as an independent in May 2012. He founded the Bright Armenia Party in 2015 and has served as its chairman since. He was reelected to the National Assembly in April 2017, leading the electoral list of the Way Out Alliance, an electoral alliance between Bright Armenia, Civil Contract and the Hanrapetutyun Party.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Edmon Marukyan's leadership of Bright Armenia party and his role in shaping Armenia's constitutional reforms have had a significant impact on the country's political landscape. His re-election to parliament in 2017 led to the formation of a new government, marking a shift in Armenia's political direction.
